customManagers.description: Track ARG <NAME>_VERSION=<value> lines in the Dockerfile when annotated with a # renovate: datasource/depName comment on the previous line.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch bumps for the agent CLIs — these ship rapidly and patches are routine.
Agent CLI minor + major bumps land as individual PRs for human review.
Group base image (debian-slim, node) bumps into a single monthly PR — these tend to land together and we don't want chatty per-image PRs.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Toolchain bumps (kubectl, helm, flux, etc.) land as individual PRs — these can break unrelated workflows and shouldn't be batched.
